description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for multiple model variants, with several colored lines and shaded bands indicating variability around each curve. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with tick marks at regular 20,000-iteration intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. A blue solid line labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)” starts near the top of the axis around 3.4 at iteration 0, drops steeply to roughly 2.9 within the early iterations, then declines gradually to about 2.62 by 140,000. An orange solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” begins near 3.4, falls quickly to around 2.8 early on, and then decreases steadily to approximately 2.52 at 140,000. A green solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” similarly starts near 3.4, drops to about 2.8 early, and trends downward to roughly 2.51 by 140,000. A red solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” starts near 3.4, descends rapidly to around 2.75–2.8 early, and continues a gradual decline to about 2.50 at 140,000. A darker blue solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” begins near 3.4, drops sharply to around 2.75–2.8 early, and then decreases to roughly 2.49 by 140,000. A purple solid line (label obscured by a gray box in the legend) starts near 3.4, falls quickly to around 2.7–2.75 early, and then gradually declines to approximately 2.47–2.48 at 140,000; each series is accompanied by a faint, same-color shaded region around the line across the full iteration range.
